name: cozy-garden

dialogue.text: Welcome to the farm! Plant crops in the soil and watch them grow. Come back when you need advice!
Wheat is the easiest crop to start with. Tomatoes take longer but sell for more!
Welcome! I buy crops and sell seeds, tools and fertilizer. I can also repair worn-out tools.

items.name: Hoe
items.description: Till grass into soil for planting

items.name: Watering Can
items.description: Water your crops to help them grow

items.name: Axe
items.description: Chop down trees and wooden objects

items.name: Scythe
items.description: Harvest crops quickly in an area

items.name: Copper Hoe
items.description: A sturdier hoe — tills with less effort

items.name: Copper Watering Can
items.description: Waters a wider area with less effort

items.name: Wood
items.description: Sturdy timber from trees and stumps

items.name: Basic Fertilizer
items.description: Improves soil quality and crop growth

items.name: Quality Fertilizer
items.description: Increases chance of higher quality crops

items.name: Flower
items.description: A beautiful flower that makes a nice gift

items.name: Old Boot
items.description: Someone lost this a long time ago

items.name: Hay
items.description: Animal feed — one serving a day keeps them happy

items.name: Furnace
items.description: Smelts ore into bars (place it, then load a recipe)

items.name: Preserves Jar
items.description: Turns crops into preserves worth more

items.name: Kitchen
items.description: A cooking station — place it, then cook nearby

items.name: Workbench
items.description: A carpentry station — place it, then build nearby

items.name: Veggie Soup
items.description: A hearty soup simmered from garden vegetables

items.name: Fruit Tart
items.description: A sweet baked tart bursting with fruit

items.name: Tool Rack
items.description: A sturdy wooden rack for hanging tools

items.name: Trail Mix
items.description: A foraged snack. Use it for a quick pick-me-up.

items.name: Enchanter's Altar
items.description: A humming altar — place it, then enchant nearby

items.name: Growth Charm
items.description: A quartz charm warm to the touch. Use it to feel its blessing.
